error[ZC-E0112]: the server address can't be used
  cause  nonsense is not HOST:PORT with an IP address (or localhost) and a port
  fix    write it like this:   zcube --server 127.0.0.1:7070 get service
  more   zcube explain E0112 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0112.html
